name: ElixApps Site Health Auditor
author: Elix Apps

sections.description:
WP Site Health is a lightweight, privacy-first website health and quality audit plugin for WordPress administrators. It performs local, non-intrusive diagnostic scans across 10 vital site categories, computing an objective Health Score (0–100) with clear, actionable improvement recommendations.

Unlike SaaS plugins that track site metrics on external servers, WP Site Health operates 100% locally on your WordPress installation. No data leaves your server, no telemetry is sent, no CDNs are loaded, and zero frontend scripts are loaded on your website.

Key Features

  • Website Health Score (0–100): Transparent score calculated from 10 diagnostic categories.
  • WordPress Core & PHP Audits: Checks WordPress core update availability, PHP version support status, and deprecation risks.
  • Plugin & Theme Health: Monitors active, inactive, and outdated plugins and themes to reduce security attack surfaces.
  • Media Library Audit: Identifies images missing ALT text (accessibility/SEO), oversized image files (>2MB), and total media storage usage.
  • Content Quality Checks: Detects published posts missing featured images, uncategorized posts, untagged posts, and outdated unmodified content.
  • Database & Data Cleanup Overview: Reports post revision bloat, auto-drafts, spam/trash items, and inactive clutter.
  • Site Configuration & Security: Verifies HTTPS SSL encryption, WP Memory Allocation, site timezone, and active object caching.
  • Local Health History: Logs local health audit scores and provides a visual trend view over time.
  • 100% Privacy & Performance: Zero external tracking, zero CDNs, zero public frontend footprint.

Privacy Notice

WP Site Health is 100% privacy-compliant.
* It does NOT collect, store, or transmit personal data.
* It does NOT connect to third-party web services or CDNs.
* It does NOT inject code or tracking pixels into your public website frontend.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the elixapps-site-health-auditor directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or install the plugin directly via the WordPress Plugins menu).
  2. Activate WP Site Health through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WP Site Health in your WordPress admin sidebar to view your website health dashboard and run health audits.
sections.faq:
Does WP Site Health send any data to external servers?

No. WP Site Health operates entirely on your local WordPress server. It does not send telemetry, user tracking, or site metrics externally.

Will WP Site Health automatically update or delete my content?

No. WP Site Health is an audit and reporting tool. It does not make destructive database changes or delete files without explicit administrator action.

Is the Health Score official from WordPress.org?

No. The score is calculated using an objective local scoring matrix designed to give administrators a clear overview of website maintenance status.
